name: The Offense of Grom'gol
summary: Commander Aggro'gosh asks you to help Grom'gol Base Camp after a scout finds ogres in a cave to the east. The settlement has already faced their attacks, and the danger remains.

sections.title: A Scout's Report
sections.body: After you help defend Grom'gol Base Camp and push back nearby ogres, Commander Aggro'gosh sends a scout to search for more. The scout finds ogres dwelling in a cave far to the east. Aggro'gosh asks you to strike at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount, so the settlement faces no further threat from them.

faq.q: Who asks for help against the ogres?
faq.answer: Commander Aggro'gosh of Grom'gol Base Camp asks you to deal with the ogres.

faq.q: Where did the scout find the ogres?
faq.answer: The scout finds them in a cave far to the east, at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.

faq.q: Why is Aggro'gosh concerned about the ogres?
faq.answer: Grom'gol has already faced nearby ogres, and the scout finds more dwelling in a cave to the east.
You helped defend Grom'gol and pushed against nearby ogres before the scout searched for more.
